links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified open access pediatric strabismus articles (baseline readability)
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL and SMOG) of LLM plain-language summaries versus the original articles; clinical fidelity rated by 2 specialists
links.effect: FKGL fell from 15.79 (SD 1.53) to 7.84 (SD 1.30), mean difference 7.95 (95% CI 7.52-8.38; P<.001). SMOG fell from 14.41 (SD 1.09) to 7.68 (SD 0.94), mean difference 6.73 (95% CI 6.42-7.04; P<.001). Fidelity was good in 81/85 (95.29%), moderate in 4 (4.71%), and poor in 0.
links.tradeoff: 4 summaries had only moderate clinical fidelity, all of review articles. Case reports kept slightly higher FKGL (mean 8.35, SD 0.89) than reviews (7.89) and original research (7.48) (adjusted P=.003).
links.quote: Following LLM simplification, the mean FKGL score significantly decreased from 15.79 (SD 1.53) to 7.84 (SD 1.30), representing a mean difference of 7.95 (95% CI 7.52-8.38; P<.001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt with specialist fidelity review
